Entry Asshai and the Shadow Lands Asshai is distant and dark in Western rumors, often associated with magic, obsidian, and unspeakable knowledge. Businessmen imagine it from routes, witchcraft enthusiasts imagine it from stories, and few people really know it; distance makes all rumors have a greater impact. Altars, relics, and prophecies can unite people and give a political claim the appearance of irrefutability.
